previous_assumption: A Kysely table's column type and the corresponding domain Record type in a module's domain/ports.ts should just match 1:1 in strictness.
correction: When a column has no DB-level CHECK constraint (e.g. machines.status, kept as plain `text` deliberately so `canTransition` is the sole enforcement — see docs/equipment-domain-design.md), the Kysely table type must stay honest as `string`. The port-level Record type (MachineRecord.status) can still legitimately be the narrower MachineStatus union, since the application is the only writer of that column and always writes through the closed enum. The repository is the deliberate, explicit narrowing boundary between the two (a small `toMachineRecord` helper doing `row as MachineRecord`) — not a place to loosen the Record type back to string, and not a reason to tighten the Kysely table type to the union (that would incorrectly claim a DB-level guarantee that doesn't exist).
